name: Deletion Semantics Conformance Fixture
description: 47 identifiers from a documented repository account termination, selected so that each exercises a distinct condition a deletion-semantics specification must handle: removal with and without a successor, erased registration, structure erasure at concept-root and version level, unresolved membership, other-author collision, unverifiable successor, non-identifiers, and a negative control of identifiers that still resolve. Every case carries its recorded classification, its verification date, and an independently observed terminal HTTP status. The source index holds 1,938 identifiers; that is not 1,938 deletions, and the fixture is explicit about the difference. One recorded class is documented as unreliable, with the disagreement retained rather than corrected, because a producer state that observation contradicts is itself a test case.
